title: "Reproducing Fig1 from Paper"
author: "Sonali Arora"
date: "Narch 12, 2026"
output:
  html_document:
    toc: true
    theme: united
---

```{r}

rm(list=ls())
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(ggpubr)

s1 = 2# size for points in PCA plot
legend_pt_size =4
plot_title_size = 25
axis_text_size = 25
axis_title_size=25
legend_text_size=25
plot_text = 10
spacing=1
chosen_margin = c(0.5,1,0.5,1)# margins:top,right,bottom,left
theme_clean <- theme_bw() +
    theme(
        plot.title = element_text(hjust=0, vjust=0, 
                                  lineheight=.8, face="bold", size=plot_title_size ),
        plot.margin=unit(chosen_margin,"cm"), 
        legend.text=element_text(size=legend_text_size),
        legend.key.height = unit(spacing, "cm"),
        legend.title=element_blank() , 
        axis.title.x=element_blank(),
        axis.text.x=element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x=element_blank(), 
        axis.title.y=element_blank(),
        axis.text.y=element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.y=element_blank())


qual_col_pals = brewer.pal.info[brewer.pal.info$category == 'qual',]
col_vector = unlist(mapply(brewer.pal, qual_col_pals$maxcolors, rownames(qual_col_pals)))

umap_data2 = read.delim("final_metadata_3_12_2026.txt.txt" , header=T, stringsAsFactors=F)

dataset_plot2= ggplot(umap_data2 %>% arrange(desc(DATASET)),  aes(PaCMAP1, PaCMAP2, color=DATASET )) +
    geom_point(size=s1) + 
    scale_color_manual(values = c(col_vector[1:3], col_vector[5:21])) + #  +
    theme_clean + 
    guides(color=guide_legend(ncol=2))

ggdf = umap_data2[ order(umap_data2$DISEASE), ]
disease_plot2= ggplot(ggdf ,  aes(PaCMAP1, PaCMAP2, color=DISEASE )) +
    geom_point(size=s1) + 
    scale_color_manual(values = c( "orange", "blue", "darkgreen", "red")) +
    theme_clean +
    guides(color=guide_legend(ncol=1))

cohort_plot2= ggplot(umap_data2 %>% arrange(desc(cohorts )),  aes(PaCMAP1, PaCMAP2, color=cohorts )) +
    geom_point(size=s1) + 
    scale_color_manual(values = c(col_vector[1:3], col_vector[5:21])) + 
    theme_clean + 
    guides(color=guide_legend(ncol=2))


mis1= ggplot(umap_data2 ,  aes(PaCMAP1, PaCMAP2, color=DISEASE )) +
    geom_point(size=s1) + 
    geom_point(data =umap_data2[which(umap_data2$DISEASE=="Adenocarcinoma"), ], aes(PaCMAP1, PaCMAP2 ))+
    scale_color_manual(values = c( "orange", "grey90", "grey90", "grey90")) +
    theme_clean +
    guides(color=guide_legend(ncol=1))

mis2= ggplot(umap_data2 ,  aes(PaCMAP1, PaCMAP2, color=DISEASE )) +
    geom_point(size=s1) + 
    geom_point(data =umap_data2[which(umap_data2$DISEASE=="Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer"), ], aes(PaCMAP1, PaCMAP2 ))+
    scale_color_manual(values = c( "grey90", "blue", "grey90", "grey90")) +
    theme_clean +
    guides(color=guide_legend(ncol=1))


mis3= ggplot(umap_data2 ,  aes(PaCMAP1, PaCMAP2, color=DISEASE )) +
    geom_point(size=s1) + 
    geom_point(data =umap_data2[which(umap_data2$DISEASE=="Small Cell Lung Cancer"), ], aes(PaCMAP1, PaCMAP2 ))+
    scale_color_manual(values = c( "grey90", "grey90", "darkgreen", "grey90")) +
    theme_clean +
    guides(color=guide_legend(ncol=1))

mis4= ggplot(umap_data2 ,  aes(PaCMAP1, PaCMAP2, color=DISEASE )) +
    geom_point(size=s1) + 
    geom_point(data =umap_data2[which(umap_data2$DISEASE=="Squamous cell carcinoma"), ], aes(PaCMAP1, PaCMAP2 ))+
    scale_color_manual(values = c( "grey90", "grey90",  "grey90", "red")) +
    theme_clean +
    guides(color=guide_legend(ncol=1))

## bar plots

sp =split(umap_data2, umap_data2$cohorts)
md1 = as.data.frame(table(sp[[5]]$DISEASE))
md1[,2] = round(md1[,2]/63*100, 2)

t1 = ggplot(md1, aes(x = "", y = Freq, fill = Var1)) + 
    geom_col(color = "black", alpha =  0.25) +
    coord_polar(theta = "y") + ggtitle("low gene ratio group") + 
    theme_void()
custom_colors <- c("orange", "blue", "darkgreen", "red")
t1 = t1 + scale_fill_manual(values = custom_colors)

md2 = as.data.frame(table(sp[[6]]$DISEASE))
md2[,2] = round(md2[,2]/133*100, 2)

t2 = ggplot(md2, aes(x = "", y = Freq, fill = Var1)) + 
    geom_col(color = "black", alpha = 0.25) +
    coord_polar(theta = "y") + ggtitle("low gene ratio group") + 
    theme_void()
t2 = t2 + scale_fill_manual(values = custom_colors)

t1_text = t1+ geom_text(aes(label = Freq), size = 8,
                        position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5)) 
t2_text = t2+ geom_text(aes(label = Freq), size = 8,
                        position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5)) 

lst = list(dataset_plot2, disease_plot2,   cohort_plot2 , t1, t2  )
pdf(file.path( "Figures/Multiplot_main_fig1_only_pacmap.pdf"),height = 20, width = 16)
ggarrange( plotlist = lst, nrow =4, ncol =3)
dev.off()

# Supp Fig1 

umap_cohort_plot2= ggplot(umap_data2 %>% arrange(desc(cohorts )),  aes(VST_UMAP1_2d, VST_UMAP2_2d, color=cohorts )) +
    geom_point(size=s1) + 
    scale_color_manual(values = c(col_vector[1:3], col_vector[5:21])) + 
    theme_clean + 
    guides(color=guide_legend(ncol=2))


tsne_cohort_plot2= ggplot(umap_data2 %>% arrange(desc(cohorts )),  aes(tSNE_1, tSNE_2, color=cohorts )) +
    geom_point(size=s1) + 
    scale_color_manual(values = c(col_vector[1:3], col_vector[5:21])) + 
    theme_clean + 
    guides(color=guide_legend(ncol=2))

stage_plot2= ggplot(umap_data2 %>% arrange(desc(AJCC_PATHOLOGIC_STAGE )),  aes(PaCMAP1, PaCMAP2, color=AJCC_PATHOLOGIC_STAGE )) +
    geom_point(size=s1) +
    geom_point(data =umap_data2[which(!is.na(umap_data2$AJCC_PATHOLOGIC_STAGE)), ], aes(PaCMAP1, PaCMAP2 ))+
    scale_color_manual(values = c(col_vector[11:15] ), na.value ="grey90") +
    theme_clean +
    guides(color=guide_legend(ncol=2))

grade_plot2= ggplot(umap_data2 %>% arrange(desc(GRADE )),  aes(PaCMAP1, PaCMAP2, color=GRADE )) +
    geom_point(size=s1) + 
    geom_point(data =umap_data2[which(!is.na(umap_data2$GRADE)), ], aes(PaCMAP1, PaCMAP2 ))+
    scale_color_manual(values = c(col_vector[5:10] ), na.value ="grey90") +
    theme_clean + 
    guides(color=guide_legend(ncol=2))

umap_data2$AGE = as.numeric(umap_data2$AGE)
myPalette <- colorRampPalette(rev(brewer.pal(11, "RdYlBu")))
sc2 <- scale_colour_gradientn(colours = myPalette(12), limits=c(0, 100), na.value = "grey90")
age_plot2= ggplot(umap_data2 %>% arrange(desc(AGE )),  aes(PaCMAP1, PaCMAP2, color=AGE )) +
    geom_point(size=s1) + 
    geom_point(data =umap_data2[which(!is.na(umap_data2$AGE)), ], aes(PaCMAP1, PaCMAP2 ))+
    sc2 + 
    theme_clean + 
    guides(color=guide_legend(ncol=1))

race_plot2= ggplot(umap_data2 %>% arrange(desc(RACE )),  aes(PaCMAP1, PaCMAP2, color=RACE )) +
    geom_point(size=s1) + 
    geom_point(data =umap_data2[which(!is.na(umap_data2$RACE)), ], aes(PaCMAP1, PaCMAP2 ))+
    scale_color_manual(values = c( "black", "red", "green" , "plum1" ), na.value ="grey90") +
    theme_clean +
    guides(color=guide_legend(ncol=1))

gender_plot2= ggplot(umap_data2 %>% arrange(desc(GENDER )),  aes(PaCMAP1, PaCMAP2, color=GENDER )) +
    geom_point(size=s1) + 
    geom_point(data =umap_data2[which(!is.na(umap_data2$GENDER)), ], aes(PaCMAP1, PaCMAP2 ))+
    scale_color_manual(values = c( "pink", "blue"), na.value ="grey90") +
    theme_clean +
    guides(color=guide_legend(ncol=1))

smoking_plot2= ggplot(umap_data2 %>% arrange(desc(SMOKING.STATUS.X )),  aes(PaCMAP1, PaCMAP2, color=SMOKING.STATUS.X )) +
    geom_point(size=s1) + 
    geom_point(data =umap_data2[which(!is.na(umap_data2$SMOKING.STATUS.X)), ], aes(PaCMAP1, PaCMAP2 ))+
    scale_color_manual(values = c( "green", "orange", "red", "black"), na.value ="grey90") +
    theme_clean +
    guides(color=guide_legend(ncol=1))


subtype= ggplot(umap_data2,  aes(PaCMAP1, PaCMAP2, color=TCGA_LUAD_expr_subtype )) +
    geom_point(size=s1) + 
    scale_color_manual(values = c( "darkgreen", "chocolate","black" ), na.value =  "grey90") + #  +
    geom_point(data =umap_data2[which(!is.na(umap_data2$TCGA_LUAD_expr_subtype)), ], aes(PaCMAP1, PaCMAP2 ))+
    theme_clean + 
    guides(color=guide_legend(ncol=2))

lst = list(
    NA, NA, umap_cohort_plot2, 
    tsne_cohort_plot2, stage_plot2, grade_plot2,  age_plot2, 
    race_plot2 , gender_plot2, smoking_plot2, NA, 
    subtype)

pdf(file.path( "../../Figures/Multiplot_Supp_fig1_3_6_2026_V2.pdf"),height = 20, width = 16)
ggarrange( plotlist = lst, nrow =4, ncol =3)
dev.off()



##  GSVA scores for T cell infammed as well as 5 gene predictor plots 

myPalette2 <- colorRampPalette(rev(brewer.pal(11, "Spectral")))
pathwy_sc <- scale_colour_gradientn(colours = myPalette2(20), limits=c(-1, 1))
   

p1= ggplot(umap_data2, aes(PaCMAP1, PaCMAP2, color=GSVA.Science_Tcell_inflamed_GEP_PMID_30309915 )) +
    geom_point(size=2) + 
    pathwy_sc +
    ggtitle(paste0("")) + theme_clean + 
    theme(legend.position = "inside", legend.position.inside =c(0.72, 0.3) )

p3= ggplot(umap_data2, aes(PaCMAP1, PaCMAP2, color=GSVA.Lung_5gene_tumor_purity_immune_PMID_PMC8216812 )) +
    geom_point(size=2) + 
    pathwy_sc +
    ggtitle(paste0("")) + theme_clean + 
    theme(legend.position = "inside", legend.position.inside = c(0.72, 0.3) )

lst = list(p1,  p3)

pdf(file.path( "Figures/updated_gsva_scores.pdf"),height = 20, width = 16)
ggarrange( plotlist = lst, nrow =4, ncol =3)
dev.off()


## Tumor Purity 

umap_data2$purity = as.numeric(umap_data2$purity*100)
myPalette <- colorRampPalette(rev(brewer.pal(5, "RdYlBu")))
sc2 <- scale_colour_gradientn(colours = myPalette(5), limits=c(0, 100), na.value = "grey90")
purity_plot2= ggplot(umap_data2 ,  aes(PaCMAP1, PaCMAP2, color=purity )) +
    geom_point(size=1) + 
    sc2 + 
    theme_clean 

pdf("Figures/purity.pdf", width = 6, height = 4)
print(purity_plot2)
dev.off()

box2 = ggplot(umap_data2 ,aes(x =cohorts, y = purity,fill =cohorts)) + geom_boxplot() + 
    theme_bw() + theme(
        plot.title = element_text(hjust=0, vjust=0, 
                                  lineheight=.8, face="bold", size=10 ),
        plot.margin=unit(chosen_margin,"cm"), 
        legend.position = "none" ,
        legend.title=element_blank() )


pdf("Figures/purity_boxplot_cohort.pdf", width = 5, height = 5)
print(box2)
dev.off()


## survival figure

# ---- Kaplan–Meier ----
fit_strict <- survfit(
    Surv(time, event) ~ cohorts,
    data = umap_data2
)

km_strict <- ggsurvplot(
    fit_strict,
    data       = umap_data2,
    pval       = FALSE,
    palette =c(col_vector[1:3], col_vector[5:21]),# 
    risk.table = TRUE,
    tables.height = 0.4,
    ggtheme    = theme_bw()
)

# Increase axis text and axis title size
km_strict$plot <- km_strict$plot +
    theme(
        axis.title = element_text(size = 16),
        axis.text  = element_text(size = 14)
    ) + xlab("Time (months)") 

# Increase risk table font size
km_strict$table <- km_strict$table +
    theme(
        axis.text  = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 14)
    ) + xlab("Time (months)") +ylab("")

pdf("Figures/SURVIVAL_all_cohorts_km_v2.pdf", height = 6, width = 5)
print(km_strict)
dev.off()


## Multi cox
clin_df = umap_data2
clin_df$cohorts <- factor(clin_df$cohorts,levels = c("A1","A2","A3", "A4" , "MD1",  "MD2", "SC", "SQ1", "SQ2"))

clin_df$SMOKING.STATUS.X = as.character(clin_df$SMOKING.STATUS.X)
clin_df$SMOKING.STATUS.X[which(clin_df$SMOKING.STATUS.X=="na")] = NA_character_
clin_df$SMOKING.STATUS.X[which(clin_df$SMOKING.STATUS.X=="Current-smoker(< 15yrs)")] = "Smoker <15yrs"
clin_df$SMOKING.STATUS.X[which(clin_df$SMOKING.STATUS.X=="Current-smoker(> 15yrs)")] = "Smoker >15yrs"
clin_df$SMOKING.STATUS.X[which(clin_df$SMOKING.STATUS.X=="Current smoker")] = "Smoker >15yrs"
clin_df$GENDER[which(clin_df$GENDER=="na")] = NA_character_

cox_strict <- coxph(
    Surv(time, event) ~ Cohorts + Gender+ Smoking.Status,
    data = clin_df
)
summary(cox_strict)

pdf("Figures/ggforest_cohorts.pdf", width =14, height = 8)
ggforest(cox_strict, data = clin_df ,   fontsize = 1.75 )
dev.off()


```
